provenance: Held-out cases for the Prolog oracle: the classical takhrīj cases (corpus/takhrij) of the five encoders the IslamQA tranche uses. A decided case has one ruling, stated with its reason. A disputed case (genuine_ikhtilāf) lists every reported position with the reasoning given for it; no position is the target by attribution (madhhab, majority or author), since a ruling stands by its proof. Disputed cases are scored only for whether the oracle takes a reported position, and form the tarjīḥ worklist. The q026 itlāf cases are destructions by the agent's own hand, so causation is direct.
